name: What can go wrong with a single-room remodel?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with a single-room remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are scope creep, hidden damage, and delays from missing materials or permit issues. Older homes in Denver-area neighborhoods can also reveal surprises behind walls, so it helps to set aside contingency space in both the budget and timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common problems are hidden damage, added costs, and delays from materials or permits. A careful site review and contingency budget reduce the chance of surprises.
